findings.finding: Subprocess zero counters are bypassable and the worker runs git before the guard.
findings.action: Remove worker subprocesses, deny descendant exec and guard every Python process entry point.

findings.finding: The parent imports production modules before the durable execution state and outside OS enforcement.
findings.action: Use import-free discovery or consume the authorization before a sandboxed preflight.

findings.finding: Worker receipts are not fully cross-validated and retain paths removed after publication.
findings.action: Freeze the receipt schema, verify every identity against actual files and publish portable identities.

findings.finding: Incomplete durable-state staging cannot recover to a technical failure.
findings.action: Recover claim-only, truncated-event and pre-rename staging states without replay.
